description.value: Secret Zone Bar & Grill is a neighbourhood sports bar near the Burquitlam SkyTrain station serving wings, burgers, pasta, and cocktails. It screens major sporting events including UFC, Champions League, NHL, NBA, and the World Cup. Online ordering and pickup make it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Burquitlam corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Secret Zone is an active sports bar and grill near Burquitlam station offering dine-in, takeout, and large group reservations. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Order your favorite meals online and pick them up fast'). No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned on the site. The OSM name 'Secret Zone' differs from the website's 'Secret Zone Bar & Grill', and OSM lists the community as North Vancouver while the website places the venue next to Burquitlam station (Coquitlam).
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Secret Zone' but the website consistently uses 'Secret Zone Bar & Grill'.

Community mismatch: OSM assigns this record to 'North Vancouver' but the venue is located next to Burquitlam station, which is in Coquitlam — the lat/lon (49.2606, -122.8906) also places it in Coquitlam, not North Vancouver.
Phone number (604-931-6600) is sourced from the website only; OSM has no phone entry to cross-check against.
Street address from the website does not include a city or postal code to confirm the full OSM address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active sports bar and grill with a live website, online ordering, and a recent OSM check date of 2026-02-11. Useful to touring cyclists as a dine-in and takeout food stop near a SkyTrain station.
